event: US Michigan consumer sentiment and inflation expectations (final, Nov), Fri 20 Nov 17:00 SAST. Fed's Cook speaks Friday (time UNVERIFIED). Weekly close tonight.

bullets.title: Bounce off lows
bullets.text: Gold hit 3,513.54 in Asian trade, its lowest since September 2025, and was back near 3,570 at about 14:50 SAST.

bullets.title: Worst week since March
bullets.text: Gold is still down about 8% this week from about 3,872 on Monday.

bullets.title: Fed hike priced
bullets.text: CME FedWatch shows about 99% odds of a quarter-point Fed hike on 9 December, and Fed speakers Paulson and Goolsbee sound hawkish.

bullets.title: Yields eased
bullets.text: The US 10-year yield is reported below 5% and down this week, which helps the bounce a little (exact level UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Forced selling
bullets.text: US stocks fell about 6% this week, and some funds sold gold to cover losses, while Indian and Chinese bargain buying cushioned the drop.

bullets.title: Very oversold
bullets.text: Daily RSI is near 25 and price is far below every moving average, so sharp bounces can happen inside the downtrend.
